title: JavaScript Foundations
description: Build durable JavaScript basics through tiny lessons, recall prompts, and real code checks.
outcomes: Write small functions with predictable return values
Use arrays, loops, and conditionals to transform data
Build and read strings with template literals and methods
Read and update plain objects immutably
Handle invalid input with guards and try/catch
Use Set and Map for uniqueness and counting
Clean, group, and sort records without mutating inputs
